results.title: A Demon's Revenge
results.overview: After the events in Belize, Peaches learns that every island in the Caribbean has its own demonic legends. She travels to Puerto Rico, where the past is now shaping her future, and this time, the evil curator is solely focused on revenge.

results.title: Son
results.overview: The example of a Mars rover overcoming difficulties on the red planet inspires a boy confined to a wheelchair.

results.title: Dependent
results.overview: In present-day Western Sydney, a devoted carer struggles with his own limitations while caring for his brother with Down syndrome and cerebral palsy, as news of a family tragedy tied to Middle Eastern conflict tests their bond.

results.title: New Jack Fury
results.overview: After his girlfriend is kidnapped by a ruthless kingpin, a former cop must seek the help of two unlawful R&B eccentrics to help save her.

results.title: Money Game$
results.overview: After successfully leading his team to crack a major fraud case, the leader of the Anti-Fraud Society, Zeng Miao Zhu, uncovers an even larger conspiracy lurking in the shadows. He then assigns elite members Lam, Arrow, Big Mouth, and Ba Jie to infiltrate the money game controlled by Tang Gang. Their mission is to become the spokespersons for the project, quickly attracting a large influx of funds while simultaneously collecting evidence of criminal activity. However, after Tang Gang reaps enormous profits, the plan takes a sudden turn.

results.title: Fakhr Al Suwaidi
results.overview: In a new step, the director of Al-Suwaidi National High School decides to establish a Sharia class, especially with the presence of a number of students with rebellious behavior.

results.title: The Last 7 Days
results.overview: A curse on their recently deceased mother leaves Tari and her brother Kadar with only seven days to free her soul and protect their family from darkness.

results.title: Ai-Me Fatal Deception
results.overview: When Aimee creates the ultimate AI device, it gives her knowledge, power, and everything she wants. But it comes at a price. As things take a dark turn, she finds herself fighting for her life to escape the very machine she built.

results.title: The Resonance
results.overview: When a sinister force threatens to blur the line between modern medicine and religion, a psychologist is forced to question the untimely death of her predecessor.

results.title: Empezar a Volver
results.overview: Rita lives alone in southern Chile, marked by the loss of her husband and newborn son during the dictatorship. After four decades, her son John returns to meet her and uncover his origins. During his brief stay, mother and son attempt to rebuild a bond shaped by uprooting and grief.

results.title: Isolated
results.overview: A nurse and her patient are trying to escape when a violent intruder starts hunting them.

results.title: The Island Between Tides
results.overview: A young woman follows a mysterious melody onto a remote tidal island. When she crosses back over at the next low tide, she emerges into a world where 25 years have passed.

results.title: Angelite
results.overview: Follows the journey of a college senior and his strained relationship with his deaf mother.

results.title: Claycat's DOOM The Dark Ages
results.overview: The animated parody of the videogame Doom The Dark Ages directed by Lee Hardcastle, starring Claycat.

results.title: Oho Enthan Baby
results.overview: Ashwin goes to actor Vishnu Vishal’s office to pitch a script and ends up narrating his love story. What the actor thinks to be an interval is Ashwin’s climax, it actually is a stoic end to his romantic relationship with Meera. With Vishnu Vishal’s pursual, Ashwin must confront his former lover again, to complete his story and begin his debut directorial.

results.title: Boy of Your Dreams
results.overview: A frantic college girl is stalked by a killer who breaks into the guest house she is renting in Idaho.

results.title: Hard Holiday
results.overview: Thirty-year-old LaDonne, a hotel housekeeper and single mother of twins, fights to stay sober and stable. When job loss and family strain push her to a breaking point and arrest, rehab offers a chance at redemption. Guided by a counselor and a kind stranger, LaDonne begins to heal. Her brave performance at a Christmas event becomes a turning point, rebuilding dreams and finding hope.

results.title: Nemurubaka: Hypnic Jerks
results.overview: The story centers on the daily life of college dorm roommates Yumi Irisu and Ruka Kujirai. Ruka, the older of the two, is constantly penniless despite her being active in a band. Irisu works part-time at a second-hand bookstore.

results.title: 20 Years Delfinario
results.overview: Revue by Markos Seferlis for his 20th anniversary at the Delfinario Theater
In the locker room before an event intended to raise funds for their club, the girls on a cheerleading team argue with their coach about the outfits they are required to wear.
